name: Corrupt Seller
background: A Temple merchant who sold sacrificial animals. Profited from the Temple system. Ejected by Jesus during the cleansing.

genericReactions.physical: My wares were scattered and destroyed. This is worthless to me.
genericReactions.testimonial: I have a license from the priests! My business is legitimate!
genericReactions.digital: Check the Temple records. My permit is valid.
genericReactions.environmental: He turned the Court of the Gentiles into a riot. It was a disaster.
genericReactions.analytical: I know my margins. He cost me a fortune.
genericReactions.prophecy: If he's a prophet, why is he attacking the House of God?
